recognize_zh: 右上與下方兩顆細胞核圓、染色質細緻，淡藍胞質四周有明顯細長的毛狀突起，是很清楚的毛狀細胞；左上另一顆細胞核較不規則、染色質較粗。
features: Two medium-sized cells with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and no conspicuous nucleoli
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm with prominent fine, radiating circumferential hair-like projections
A third lymphoid cell at upper left with slightly irregular nucleus and more clumped chromatin
Background normocytic red cells and platelets without significant abnormality
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and pale gray-blue cytoplasm bearing prominent fine circumferential hair-like projections. An additional lymphoid cell with a slightly irregular nucleus and coarser chromatin is present at the upper left. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells, suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL villous lymphocytes have short villi concentrated at one or both poles and are CD103/CD25/CD123 negative.
HCL-v cells show a prominent single nucleolus and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Artifactual cytoplasmic fraying occurs at the feathered edge and in otherwise small mature lymphocytes, whereas hairy cells show projections throughout the smear with fine chromatin.
